subject.title: fix(ollama): remote Ollama streaming stalls at model_call:started on slow hosts

question: Should native Ollama streaming treat provider `timeoutSeconds` as an idle/no-progress timeout while chunks arrive, matching sibling streaming transports, even though current docs describe it as a total guarded-fetch abort?
rationale: This is a compatibility-facing interpretation of an existing provider config knob, so code correctness alone cannot settle whether to change the public timeout contract.

options.title: Accept idle-timeout semantics with proof
options.body: Require the docs update and redacted remote/slow Ollama proof, then allow the narrow refresh fix to proceed.

options.title: Preserve total-timeout semantics
options.body: Reject this shape and ask for a different fix that keeps `timeoutSeconds` as a total request cap while addressing the stall.

recommendation.title: Accept idle-timeout semantics with proof
recommendation.body: Require the docs update and redacted remote/slow Ollama proof, then allow the narrow refresh fix to proceed.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent history in the Ollama native stream path where this timeout behavior lives.
